Signalsmith Stretch — vendored WASM pitch/time-stretch module
=============================================================

File:     SignalsmithStretch.mjs
Source:   https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch
Build:    official web release build (web/release/SignalsmithStretch.mjs),
          byte-identical to upstream. Single-file: the WASM binary is embedded
          as a base64 data-URI, so there is no separate .wasm to fetch and the
          module self-registers its AudioWorklet via a Blob module URL.
sha256:   97530b11d5bc01015af4cde40d6aa55ff10c40aa1294ca4c8c5762027d517a46
License:  MIT (see LICENSE.txt) — Copyright (c) 2022 Geraint Luff /
          Signalsmith Audio Ltd.

Why it's here: replaces the previous vendored phaze phase-vocoder worklet
(public/pitch-processor.js) for the core key-shift feature. phaze snapped
shifted spectral peaks to the nearest FFT bin (~18 cents flat at +12);
Signalsmith reproduces pitch exactly and has cleaner transients. Formant
compensation is intentionally left off (its default) — it degraded real music
in A/B testing. Local DSP only: no network, no catalog, nothing hosted.

Loaded lazily via dynamic import() from useAudioEngine.js only on a secure
context, so it never enters the main app bundle.
